title: Drain the paginated vCenter authorization roles collection

verification.network: loopback only; no live VMware endpoint is contacted
verification.description: Compiles the client with the harness, refuses to run if any protected file was modified, then drives the client against a loopback mock pinned to docs/contract.json across four traversals: paged with a filter unset, paged with is_system=false, paged with is_system=true, and paged while the caller leaves every optional property unset. Asserts the exact request wire shape from the mock's request log (method, path, session header, Accept, permitted query keys, omission of unset optionals, percent-encoded verbatim marker echo, request count, complete drain) and the exact rendered report.
